description: Crypto token UNLOCK calendar from DefiLlama: every scheduled vesting cliff and emission-rate change across ~370 tracked tokens in a date window (e.g. "which token unlocks are scheduled this week", "unlocks over $10M between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-12"). Returns per event: date, token, tokens unlocked, USD value at the current DefiLlama price (with the price time), share of circulating supply, and the recipients (investors, team, ecosystem…). Default window is today through 7 days out.

from.description: Window start, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC, inclusive). Default: today.

limit.description: Max events returned, sorted by date then USD value (default 100, max 500).

min_usd.description: Only cliff unlocks worth at least this many USD at the current price (e.g. 1000000). Excludes emission-rate changes, which have no single USD amount.

to.description: Window end, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC, inclusive). Default: from + 7 days.

token.description: Restrict to tokens whose name, symbol or DefiLlama slug contains this text (e.g. "hyperliquid", "ARB").

name: defi_token_unlocks
title: Defi Token Unlocks
